messages:
Ava (Finance): Hey team — batch invoice run `batch_20260322_17` finished with partial failures. Some customers got multiple invoices and others got invoices missing the split usage lines for reserved compute. Not sure if this is a downstream merge issue or a pricing override. 

Rohan (Billing Eng): Can you paste the batch id + sample invoice id? I’ll pull the generator logs.

Ava (Finance): batch_20260322_17. Example impacted acct ACME (acct_id=55678) — invoice INV-55678-20260322 and INV-55678-20260322-dup were both created; the original had two usage line items, the dup only has subscription lines (no gpu_hours). Also no credit_memo created for the prorated reserved credit.

Lena (Revenue Ops): I pulled the ledger for acct 55678 — I see two OUTGOING invoices and no credit memo. One invoice total matches expected (~$12,540) and the duplicate shows ~$6,300 (missing GPU usage). The system also shows FLAG pricing-experiment:beta-rate active for this org.

InvoiceBot: [system] invoice_generator v2.14 attempted merge of usage batches: ERROR merge_conflict: overlapping_row_keys. Job: job_20260322_17_9. Created provisional invoice INV-55678-20260322-dup (status: issued).

Rohan (Billing Eng): Thanks. That merge_conflict matches a recent change in the batching code where we optimistic-merge per-customer. If a pricing override is present the key namespace changed (we store usage shard by rate_key). Looks like the rate_key drifted so the same usage set got split across two shards and the generator treated them as disjoint — hence a duplicate invoice missing lines.

Marcus (Acct Mgr): This is customer-impacting — ACME already pinged support about a "mismatched invoice amounts" ticket. We need to reissue and notify. Do we need finance approval to void the erroneous invoice before reissue?

Ava (Finance): We need approval to void the duplicate invoice and issue a credit memo + reissue a consolidated invoice that includes the missing usage lines. Estimate net change: 0 (just consolidation), but customer-facing confusion. Approve?

Lena (Revenue Ops): +1. Approve void + reissue. Also recommend we add a reconciliation hold if billing-run detects merge_conflict for a customer so we don't auto-issue until human review.

Rohan (Billing Eng): Plan: (1) run backfill tool to combine shards for batch_20260322_17 and produce a corrected invoice payload, (2) create credit memo to void INV-55678-20260322-dup, (3) emit new invoice INV-55678-20260322-reissue with combined lines, (4) mark original issued invoice as replaced. Command I'll run (dry-run first):

```
invoice_generate --batch batch_20260322_17 --merge-shards --dry-run
invoice_generate --batch batch_20260322_17 --merge-shards --apply --note "reissue for merge_conflict; replace INV-55678-20260322-dup"
```

Rohan (Billing Eng): Also filing a dev ticket to gate auto-issue on merge_conflict: BIL-8973.

Ava (Finance): Approve applied. Please include a customer-facing note and flag the invoice as "reissued due to system merge". Marcus can you draft the email?

Marcus (Acct Mgr): Will draft and send after we confirm the reissued invoice. Quick ask: can we include the cost breakdown and a one-line apology? :)

Rohan (Billing Eng): Running dry-run now. Snapshot of error from logs for visibility:

```
2026-03-22T17:02:13Z [invoice_generator] job_20260322_17_9 ERROR merge_conflict: shard_key=usage:rate_key:0x7f9a drifted from expected 0x5a3c
payload: {"acct":55678, "usage_rows":124, "shards":2}
```

Ava (Finance): Thanks. Please also include whether any other accounts hit the same conflict — if it’s widespread we should pause the pipeline.

Rohan (Billing Eng): Dry-run shows 8 affected accounts in this batch (including 55678). I'll hold the apply until we confirm scope.

Lena (Revenue Ops): I'll check accounting cutoffs — if we reissue before month-end it's simpler. If past cutoff we might need an adjustment next period.

Ava (Finance): Good call. Timestamp: quick decision window of 2 hours to avoid next-day batch. Keep thread updated.

Marcus (Acct Mgr): Noted. I'll standby for the reissue and craft customer note template.

InvoiceBot: [system] ticket created: BIL-8973 (Auto-issue gating for merge_conflict).

Rohan (Billing Eng): Update: ran apply for batch_20260322_17 after approvals. Created credit memo CM-55678-20260322 and new invoice INV-55678-20260322-reissue. Marked INV-55678-20260322-dup as void. I'll follow up with a reconciliation report in ~30m.

Ava (Finance): Thanks all. Please attach reconciliation report here when ready and include the list of affected accounts so ops can reach out.

Lena (Revenue Ops): Will do — adding postmortem to BIL-8973 with recommended change: hold-on-merge_conflict + add deterministic rate_key hashing for experiments.

Marcus (Acct Mgr): Customer notified. They appreciated the quick fix. :thumbsup:
